name: openspec_build_prompt
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

instr.description: An openspec_instructions-shaped result (artifactId, instruction, rules, resolvedOutputPath, template consulted). Non-dict values are treated as {}.

goal.description: Change goal/description text embedded verbatim into the prompt.

feedback.description: Prior review feedback text appended to the prompt when non-blank; omitted from the prompt otherwise.

prompt.description: Composed prompt instructing the agent to write exactly one OpenSpec artifact file, including rules, template, and any review feedback.
